sentences.text: A towing vessel whose tow severely restricts her ability to deviate from her course shows the restricted-in-ability-to-maneuver lights and shapes in addition to her towing lights.
Inconspicuous, partly submerged vessels or objects being towed, like a fuel bladder, show all-round white lights at the ends, with extra lights if very wide, and a diamond shape at the aftermost end.
Where it’s impracticable to light a vessel or object being towed, all possible measures shall be taken to light it or show its presence.

And a vessel not normally engaged in towing, such as a boat towing another in distress, isn’t required to show towing lights when that’s impracticable, but must indicate the relationship, for example by illuminating the towline.
